W1.8.4.4.10.2.2 is complete and published at 57b91ee: matched fixed graph-on/off MCP control, same-thread three-turn controller, cumulative/source-version accounting, isolated target preparation and independent Anvil/Loci behavioral oracles. Local scripted and real MCP checks pass; normal Loci gains only an internal shared selection seam and no public graph toggle. No measured episode or campaign freeze exists. Next W1.8.4.4.10.2.3 must validate the actual host and freeze the campaign; current nested macOS sandbox fails exit71 during native thread creation, before any model turn. Provider/partial-usage/instruction/isolation checks remain unproven. Historical v4 gates and final Objective acceptance remain unchanged.

Vik selected implementation with "Great let's do it". Five implementation leaves are complete under the decomposed parent; Manifest reads54/58 completed leaves. Every new round retains its own child identity. Publication57b91ee1e75474636f9b2c43f9542344964f4218 is verified against origin/master. Source: /Users/brummerv/loci/benchmarks/complete_work/README.md and .scratch/deterministic-graph-retrieval/episode-implementation-execution.md.

Both graph arms use identical descriptors, anchor selection and normal source paging; off omits traversal/enrichment. Real MCP validates exact bytes across edits and strict target scope. The three fixed turns retain prompt/thread identities, caps and not_reached failures. Accounting deduplicates cumulative usage, separates downstream effort, rejects missing scheduled rows, and treats interrupted capture as partial usage with unknown complete totals. Delivery joins retain ambiguous/missing telemetry and unchanged-source-span repeats without calling graph delivery model reliance. Stage evaluators restore archived source rather than reread final files.

Relevant checks include39 control/product checks,18 controller/runtime/accounting/isolation checks before the added partial-usage control, all8 final accounting checks,7 delivery checks and2 real-MCP three-stage integration checks. Anvil oracle5 tests,37 original focused regressions and eight passing reference checks distinguish unchanged/faulty output. Loci oracle5 tests pass the disposable reference and reject broad-name, unsafe-path and stale-index faults. Manual claims/invariant severity/rework review remains separate. No production .direnv feature was applied.

A fresh396-file Loci export installed pinned dependencies and preindexed successfully. Initial transitive tree-sitter0.26 setup segfaulted; preparation now constrains0.25.2 from the target uv.lock. Full dependency provenance and failed setup diagnostics are retained. Prepared config: /private/tmp/complete-work-loci-prepared-success.n10Owv/run/observer/run.json. It is a diagnostic preparation, not a frozen campaign input.

The actual installed App Server initializes and advertises Terra/high. Native own-canary command probes fail sandbox_apply Operation not permitted, including an approved tool retry. Integrated preflight later fails at thread/start loading AGENTS.md under the same required filesystem policy; zero turn/start submissions occurred. This is an OS/runtime restriction, not an automatic approval-review rejection. The boundary was not weakened. See .scratch/deterministic-graph-retrieval/episode-runtime-capability/controller-preflight.json.

The next card is W1.8.4.4.10.2.3, blocked pending a host that can enforce isolation. It must verify effective host instructions/config, dependency matching, model access, native multi-turn/partial usage/outer-call capture and stopping before publishing the exact freeze. Eight measured episodes remain .10.2.4; analysis remains .10.2.5; Vik's final acceptance remains .10.3. The pilot still measures whole-workflow value rather than initial-packet causality, billed dollars or general workload value.

## How We Use It

Use Loci when codebase navigation matters. Treat its current MCP read surface as
the freshness boundary for indexed repository context. A SessionStart hook can
report an existing cache or seed an uncached repository, but that startup state
is not proof that cached content is current.

Treat MCP storage as a client-registration and process boundary, not a tool-call
choice. Each host supplies one explicit absolute store root and namespace; the
server binds that identity immutably before opening stdio. Codex and Claude use
distinct roots and namespaces by default. Missing configuration,
cross-namespace reuse, unsafe or malformed identity state, and silent adoption
of a populated legacy root fail closed. Intentional sharing requires both hosts
to configure the same root and namespace explicitly; repository paths remain
the only storage-adjacent input on normal navigation tools.

Normal context retrieval runs graph policy deterministically. The agent supplies
its query or known anchors; Loci chooses supported calls, types, references and
imports under fixed work and output budgets. Exact source paging hydrates selected
source. There is no per-request intent, family, direction, hop or enable-graph
choice. Native endpoints, complete selected proof, freshness and explicit unknowns
remain required. Source locators do not establish prior issuance or delivery.

Legacy primitive and opt-in traversal tools are an explicit operator diagnostic
surface; their exact-neighbour contract remains contains-only. Unresolved or
unsupported observations never become guessed trusted edges. Actual native
receipts now establish the repaired host's complete binding proof, browser and
renderer controls, exact source paging and byte accounting. The selection policy
gives direct selected-anchor relationships priority over incidental ownership
expansion without increasing budgets or weakening proof.

The selected next repair now prioritizes one representative supported input-type
path per selected callable before ordinary family interleaving. Explicit pairs
retain precedence; one shared neighborhood allowance and accepted proof/packing
transitions preserve budgets and controls. Structural input-role evidence
excludes generic constraints and body annotations. Unsupported multiline and
ambiguous nested roles remain ordinary edges.

Normal retrieval and reads now issue deterministic 30-character handles for
exact continuation. A bounded per-repository cache retains the full canonical
locator and survives process restart. Only final emitted references are persisted.
Unknown or evicted handles require fresh retrieval; legacy encoded locators
remain readable. Exact repository/hash/extent/UTF8 and source-containment checks
remain. Handles are not authorization credentials and still require exact reuse.
